# Channel

Channel is a Contract type used in Contracts event routing and channel progression. It inherits `order`, which provides ordering information. No default, requiredness or ordering direction is specified here.

Channel processing checks channel lifetime and applicable contextual constraints. Associated checkpoints preserve the original event’s exact identity and validate the timestamp as an Integer under the applicable range and progression rules. An event reference alone does not establish the event’s validity or the authority of its source; signed admission belongs to Coordination.

Checkpoint advancement is part of successful local execution. Missing required evidence, invalid evidence or incomplete execution must leave the prior stable state unchanged. Local completion does not itself establish durable host publication or confirm an external outcome.

This declaration does not detail concrete event-selection or progression rules. Its governing specification is an experimental candidate, not a qualified release or an implementation-conformance claim.
